subject: Re: Hosted API pricing request — commit tiers & competitor price match
messages:
From: Alex Carter <alex.carter@novushealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API pricing inquiry and competitor match

Hi Soojin,

We ran a quick TCO comparison and Redwood looks promising — especially given your caching and batching tooling. Novus is projecting 30M tokens/month starting July with a ramp to ~80M tokens/month by Q4.

Two asks from procurement: can Redwood provide (1) a committed monthly tier structure (term + minimums) and (2) whether you can match the headline per-token rates we were quoted from other vendors (OpenAI quoted $0.0006/1k prompt-token-equivalent, Anthropic quoted a similar figure on generation tokens). We need a clear table showing unit price at different commit levels plus any minimums or uplift for private deployments.

Latency SLOs matter; our product needs sub-200ms p50 on short chat flows. Also call out whether request/response token counting is symmetric (we bill both prompt + completion).

Can you send a short proposal and a commitment template we can review with our procurement team?

Thanks,
Alex
Director of Product, Novus Health

--
Novus Health
Alex.Carter@novushealth.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@novushealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-16T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing inquiry and competitor match

Alex — thanks for the details, and congrats on the rapid ramp plan. A couple quick clarifying questions so we give a tight, comparable table:

- Is the 30M target across all product flows, or concentrated in a small set of endpoints? (This affects batching profiles.)
- What’s the rough split input vs output tokens (example: 30% prompt / 70% completion)?
- Do you need a VPC/private deployment or will hosted suffice for now?
- Any strict approval deadline from procurement?

I attached a lightweight pricing-model.xlsx (stub) so you can see how we typically present commit tiers. Short answer: we typically bill both prompt + completion tokens; we can propose per-1k-token rates and an optional flat surcharge for private deployments. We also offer a 90-day pilot with reduced minimums to validate latency and throughput.

I’ll pull together a formal commit-tier proposal and CC finance/legal for contract terms once I have your split and deployment preference.

Best,
Soojin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing-model.xlsx (spreadsheet — model of tier pricing and sample math)
From: Alex Carter <alex.carter@novushealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@novushealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-17T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing inquiry and competitor match

Soojin — thanks. Answers inline:

- Volume distribution: initially concentrated in our triage/chat endpoint (about 70% of traffic) with plans to add 2 more endpoints later.
- Token split: roughly 40% prompt / 60% completion today; completions expected to grow to 65% as we expand assistive features.
- Hosted is fine for now; we may require VPC in Q4 for regulated data.
- Procurement timeline: we'd like final pricing and a draft commitment by May 27 to stay on track for a July go-live.

As for competitor pricing — the quick quotes we received: OpenAI listed a blended effective rate around $0.0006 per 1k prompt-token equivalent for the volume bands they proposed; Anthropic had similar public numbers. We need Redwood to be within ~10% of that blended effective price or have a compelling justification (performance/latency/feature delta) to move forward.

Happy to hop on a 30-min call if that helps.

Alex
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-19T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Novus Health — pricing posture and recommended offer (internal)

Rafael / Marissa — looping you in early. Novus (NW-9387) is asking for a competitor price match vs OpenAI/Anthropic. They plan 30M/month -> 80M/month by Q4; hosted today, VPC later. Procurement wants a decision by 27-May.

Proposed approach:
1) Offer a 12-month commitment with three tiers (monthly committed tokens):
   - Tier A: 10M/mo — $0.0012 per 1k tokens (baseline)
   - Tier B: 30M/mo — $0.00085 per 1k tokens (recommended entry point)
   - Tier C: 75M/mo — $0.00065 per 1k tokens (aggressive, matches blended headline at scale)
2) Pilot: 90-day pilot at Tier B effective rate but with a 50% credit up to 10M tokens to validate latency/quality.
3) Private deployment uplift: +10% on unit price for VPC/on-prem sizing and reserved capacity.
4) Feature/ops value: Include Redwood Optimize consultancy (one-time tuning) and 30-day rollouts instrumented in Console as part of enterprise support.
5) Non-negotiables: minimum 3-month notice for downgrades; 30-day SLA ramp for dedicated capacity.

Why this? The Tier C figure gets us into the same ballpark as their OpenAI quote at scale but preserves margin at smaller commitments. The pilot makes it low-risk. If procurement pushes for lower initial pricing, we can trade a longer term (18–24 months) or a simple revenue-share credit.

Attachments: I drafted the commitment term sheet stub (Novus_Redwood_COMMIT_v1.pdf). Please flag any legal/finance exposures — specifically: termination windows, data routing for VPC, and audit log retention.

Thanks,
Soojin

(Internal — do not forward the draft without redline from legal)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@novushealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@novushealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, legal@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-22T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing inquiry and competitor match — Redwood offer

Alex — thanks for the quick turn. Per your timeline, please find our proposed offer below and the commitment stub attached. We structured this to be comparable to the OpenAI/Anthropic blended numbers you shared while preserving the operational guarantees Novus needs.

Summary offer (per 1k tokens, prompt + completion counted):
- Pilot (90 days): Tier B pricing with 50% token credit up to 10M tokens (valid for latency/throughput validation)
- Tier A (10M/mo): $0.0012 per 1k tokens
- Tier B (30M/mo): $0.00085 per 1k tokens
- Tier C (75M/mo): $0.00065 per 1k tokens
- VPC/Private deployment: +10% uplift on unit price (covers reserved GPU pools and isolated networking)
- Term length: 12 months (we can discuss 18/24 month term for additional discount)
- SLA: p50/p95 latency targets instrumented in Console; 99.9% uptime SLA for hosted endpoints (with defined remedies in the commitment doc)
- Included: one Redwood Optimize engagement (model recommendations + batching config), token-level cost dashboards, and two on-call support seats during rollout.

Why choose Redwood: we can demonstrate lower delivered latency due to our runtime and batching strategy, and our Console gives token-level cost visibility that most quoted vendors do not provide natively. For your use case (chat-heavy, sub-200ms p50 need), we can provide a short pilot test harness to validate p50 targets before you ramp.

Next steps:
1) Review attached Novus_Redwood_COMMIT_v1.pdf and mark legal redlines by May 27.
2) If acceptable, sign pilot addendum; we’ll provision test keys and a sample dataset ingest window.
3) Finance will issue an initial invoice for the first month committed on pilot start (net 30).

If procurement wants a hard price-match clause, we can consider a limited price-match guarantee for the first 6 months if Novus shares the competing commercial term sheets (NDA required). Otherwise we prefer the model above plus a term-extension path in exchange for further discounts.

Happy to discuss on a call this week — I’m available Thursday afternoon PST.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0193

Attachments: Novus_Redwood_COMMIT_v1.pdf (commitment draft)
